summary: OpenAI's Greg Brockman announced an 80% price cut on the Luna model, calling it the most price-efficient model in its class.

mechanisms.reason: An 80% price cut on a named model is a plainly stated, large reduction in inference cost.
mechanisms.quote: we've cut prices on luna by 80%, making it by far the most price-efficient model in its class.

practices.reason: A stated 80% price cut on an existing model changes the cost calculus for teams already using or considering Luna.
practices.quote: we've cut prices on luna by 80%, making it by far the most price-efficient model in its class.
